comment: Level 2. Read by BOTH the game (controlquest/gameplay/level_data.py) and the engine (engine_server/level_rules/common.py). Calibrated with engine_server/calibrate.py.

knobs.name: N
knobs.label: Horizon
knobs.help: Steps the MPC plans ahead (Δt = 0.1 s each). A longer horizon sees the wall earlier, but every solve gets bigger.

knobs.name: stop
knobs.label: Terminal stop
knobs.help: Every plan must end at rest (terminal constraint). Then a way to stop always exists, but the ball may only drive as fast as it can stop within the horizon.
